claims.quote: We have recruited 20,000 college graduates this year and through March, that will be the number.

pushback.topic: Revenue compression vs expansion from AI
pushback.quote: Could you also elaborate what do you think is the incremental opportunity is $300 bn to $400 bn on new services. Could you elaborate what would be the potential for the net opportunity adjusting for the compression

pushback.topic: Pricing models and margins for AI projects
pushback.quote: How should we think about how the pricing is evolving in or pricing model rather is evolving in those kind of projects and any rough or, you know, a framework at least to think about margins as well

pushback.topic: Value capture and margin sharing with clients
pushback.quote: So my question is, is there a way for Infosys to capture that value better? And does AI kind of result in any change to that, either for good or for worse or it really does not matter?

calls.tone: Confident and visionary, emphasizing AI leadership, operational execution, and readiness for technological transformation.

So why have the number of employees declined?

pushback.quote: Why decide to leave at a time like now, instead of perhaps looking at an extension? I wanted to understand. And with the new CEO coming in, any mandate for the new CEO that you could highlight for us more clearly? And perhaps that is something the investors would also want to know? And then on the earnings, of course, the reason for this revision downwards, if you could give us a little more colour on what you are seeing in the environment, where is the weakness?

pushback.topic: AI revenue lumpiness and TCV conversion
pushback.quote: Salil, if you could tell us your biggest achievement and what will you miss the most and what is next coming for you? On the quarterly performance, how has been the TCV conversion because that is a worry that investors have? And the third question is, two of your peers have highlighted that AI revenue is slightly lumpy and it could be 1 or 2 quarters post which you will have to go and get those deals again. So is that something that Infosys is also seeing?
Some of your competitors like Tech M have been talking about irrational competitive pricing. Wipro has also spoken about that a bit. So what are you seeing in the environment?

calls.tone: Prudent and confident in long-term AI strategy despite near-term macro and guidance headwinds.

credibility.line: Management reliably hits operating margin targets of 20%-22%, but repeatedly walked back FY27 constant currency growth guidance.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed 1.5% YoY constant currency growth in Q2 FY27, while reported rupee revenue grew 10.7% YoY to ₹49,244 crore.
Management claimed Q2 FY27 operating margin was stable at 21%, matching reported Sep 2026 EBIT margin of 21.0%.
Management claimed stable margins for FY26, consistent with full-year EBITDA margin holding at 24.0%.

bull: EBIT margin remained steady at 21.0% in Sep 2026, within 20%-22% guidance.
AI revenue share grew from 5.5% in Q3 FY26 to 10.5% in Q2 FY27.
Strong 5-year cash conversion at 1.1 OCF/PAT and low leverage with D/E of 0.09.
bear: FY27 constant currency growth guidance cut twice from 1.5%-3.5% down to 1%-2%.
Operating cash flow declined from ₹35,694 crore in Mar 2025 to ₹33,986 crore in Mar 2026.
PAT growth decelerated to 6.3% YoY in Sep 2026 from 12.3% YoY in Jun 2026.
watch: Completion of 20,000 college graduate hiring target for FY27.
EBIT margin staying within 20%-22% guidance range in Q3 FY27.
Large deal conversion into revenue following $5.2 bn TCV reported in Q2 FY27.
